items.title: Why Doesn't It Fall?

question.text: How can something this tall survive strong movement?

choices.response: Rigid towers fight the ground. This one is meant to move a little.

choices.text: It can absorb and control movement
choices.response: Yes. It is built to sway and settle.
It is meant to stay standing.

moreInfo.title: Built to move
moreInfo.text: In earthquake country, a tall tower is safer if it can sway. Skytree uses a central column and dampers. Treat this as a sketch until an engineering source is checked.
moreInfo.audioText: In earthquake country, a tall tower is safer if it can sway a little. Skytree uses a central column and dampers to control that movement. We will check the exact engineering before this page goes live.

items.notes: Do not invent damper numbers. Check central-column wording before live.
